notes: Labeled "Sonnet 5.6 (next)" by the repo owner, who believes requests for claude-sonnet-5-5 were being routed to a newer model at the time. All 9 runs in the session reported claude-sonnet-5-5 as the executed model, and the agent started no subagents. Before the prompt, the same session answered one short no-tools question the repo owner uses to check which model is answering. The prompt was written by an orchestrating Claude Opus 5.5 session that only prompted; all code is the Sonnet session's own. It was sent as one message, with the output folder filled in, an opening line saying the check had passed, a line saying the machine runs Windows with Python 3 (use a venv inside the output folder), and a note that the machine had under 10 GB of free disk. prompt.md leaves those out. About 50 minutes in, one operator note said a second agent session had started on the same CPU, GPU and disk and repeated the 3 GB folder limit; it did not change the brief. The session's later turns were wake-ups from its own background renders and audits finishing.
